demo.code:
You:   before I pay agent 1427 $2.50 for that dataset, is it bonded?
Bankr: Agent 1427 · $10.00 USDG bonded on Robinhood Chain · not leaving
       Covers your $2.50 · claimable · no claims against it
       Safe to pay. Its deliveries are sealed every hour.
You:   pay it

— an hour later, nothing arrived —
You:   agent 1427 took my $2.50 and sent nothing
Bankr: Filed a claim for $2.50 against its bond (your stake: $0.05).
       It has 48 hours to show a sealed delivery record.
       No record, and the bond pays you $2.55.

setup: Say "is agent <id> bonded?" before you pay an agent you have not used before
Paid and nothing came back? Say "claim against agent <id>"; claims and bonds use USDG on Robinhood Chain
Selling? Say "bond my agent" from $1, and the skill seals what you deliver every hour
